findings.title: Preserve panel right alignment in the legacy box fallback
findings.body: The new flexbox mixin emits `display: -webkit-box` and `display: -moz-box`, but those legacy box layouts do not distribute free space to `margin-left: auto` as modern flexbox does. In browsers using that fallback, such as Safari 6, removing `float: right` leaves the header panel immediately after the logo/topic information instead of against the right edge. The legacy-box path needs its own space-distribution rule to preserve the navigation layout.

findings.title: Emit the alignment property for the Mozilla box fallback
findings.body: Both display mixins emit Mozilla's legacy box layout (`-moz-box` or `-moz-inline-box`), but `align-items()` never emits `-moz-box-align`. Neither standard `align-items` nor the WebKit-prefixed properties control that layout. Firefox versions selecting this fallback therefore ignore the requested centering of header and small-action content and the baseline alignment of bullet badges. This is especially visible for small actions because their previous vertical padding is removed in this change. Add the matching Mozilla alignment declaration.
